title: The heat
logline: August in the garage: the door rolled up, a box fan on the floor, the pup flat on the concrete, the drafting table with its paper curling. A page of the private work drawn in the heat that curls it.

panels.composition: The garage with its door rolled up in August light, a box fan on the floor, a small three-legged dog lying flat on the concrete, a drafting table with sheets curling in the heat.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage with its door rolled up in hard August light, a box fan on the floor, a small three-legged dog lying flat on the concrete and a drafting table with paper sheets curling, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
